name: Historic Areas of Istanbul
description: Istanbul's old core sits on the Bosphorus peninsula, where Europe meets Asia, and has been a centre of power for over 2,000 years. Here you can walk between the Roman Hippodrome, the 6th-century Hagia Sophia with its vast dome, and the 16th-century Süleymaniye Mosque. Topkapı Palace, the Sultan Ahmed Mosque and the ancient city walls are also within the protected areas.
